gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-hind: Raw and tactical up top, with Capture Smallz in its big-bodied lowercase, then Hind steps in with a drawn-string steadiness and c endings that never curl inward. One shouts a little, the other just talks.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-nunito: Capture Smallz is raw and tactical, its big-bodied lowercase leaning hard into the display role. But if the heading shrinks, that bluntness fades, while Nunito keeps its round bowls and open terminals friendly.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-pilcrow-rou: Tactical and rough-edged, the heading leads with a low-contrast swagger. Capture Smallz hits hardest as a loud display line, whereas Pilcrow Rounded earns its place with warm, tall lowercase and big counters beneath.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-quicksand: Capture Smallz brings a raw, tactical punch through big-bodied lowercase, like a stencil with attitude. Quicksand then takes over with bulb-round bowls and uniform bars, so a long passage glides along gently, with terminals held well clear of the stem.
gen-dafont-college-fs-quicksand: Quicksand reads softly, with tall bowls like blown glass bulbs and terminals that finish well clear of the stem. College is the one with authority, its thick curves and big counters made for display, while Quicksand simply carries the text.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-alpino: Alpino reads cozy and casual, with tight spacing and curve endings kept well apart beneath its tall bodies. Its strength is how Conthrax stays wide and geometric against it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-familjen-grotesk: Wide, geometric and sharply clean, Conthrax has joins that never thin out where strokes meet the stems. It earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-hind: Conthrax is geometric and clean, its wide-mouthed a and tall bodies pulling the eye along like a single thread. Hind sits next to it with a drawn-string steadiness, a quieter and more professional companion.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-nunito: Nunito reads approachably, with big round bowls and terminals that finish well clear of the stem. Conthrax, with its flat fineliner line, gives the pairing a crisp geometric edge that the rounded text softens.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded reads warm, with big counters in a tall lowercase and curves that refuse to close, though letters nearly touch. Conthrax is best at crisp geometric display; the body font is best at being friendly.
